Components / Reasoning

Chain of Thought

The multi-step reasoning list — distinct from reasoning, which stays the single collapsible trace. Ordered steps with per-step status joined by a rail; the disclosure reuses the reasoning lifecycle (auto-open on stream, auto-close after, user toggle stands it down) rather than forking it. The collapsed badge counts steps from data — the collapsed content is unmounted, so the count must not live in the tree.

  • v0.2.1
  • component
  • nativewind
  • uniwind
  • runs in Expo Go

Install

npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/nativewind/chain-of-thought.json
npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/uniwind/chain-of-thought.json

Usage

(o) => ( <ChainOfThought defaultOpen={o.defaultOpen === true} isStreaming={o.isStreaming === true}> <ChainOfThoughtHeader label="Porting web-preview" steps={[{ status: 'completed' }, { status: 'running' }, { status: 'pending' }]} /> <ChainOfThoughtContent> <ChainOfThoughtStep label="Read the web original" description="web-preview.tsx:1-260" status="completed" /> <ChainOfThoughtStep label="Swap the iframe" description="react-native-webview with the scheme allowlist" status="running" /> <ChainOfThoughtStep label="Declare the peer" description="react-native-webview in registry.json" status="pending" isLast /> </ChainOfThoughtContent> </ChainOfThought> )
